carried_rule: Of the head's three seeds (st5-s1..st5-s3, best epoch), the carried head is the one with the median standardised summed score on validation (seed 314 scoring ordinals 500-1499), on the control of record's scale (calib.gate4.summed_score with calib.gate4.scale_of of the control of record).
shuffled_rule: The encoder-only shuffled head (st5-encshuf: E-w's encoder state permuted across rows each epoch, sds, proxy features, C's code and errors kept) is scored on validation at its best and at its last epoch as distinct models (st5-encshuf-best, st5-encshuf-last). If either one's standardised summed score minus the control of record's (paired, clustered, 97.5%) lies wholly below zero, a G5-d pass is void (recorded as not passed). The test gate reads the outcome from validation.json by the digest in carried.json.
validation_rule: The carried head goes to test only if, on validation, no check (G5-a to G5-e) fails and each overall point lies inside its band (coverage95 of range and speed in [0.92, 0.98]; hit - P within +/-0.04; slope in [0.75, 1.33]; log gain above 0; AUC above 0.55; head - control below 0; points identical and mass error within 1e-6). The per-slice checks count only as fail or pass (interval wholly outside the band, or not). Otherwise seed 320 is not generated and the record says so; the follow-on is decided as SRD section 5.
follow_on: SRD section 5: proposed in the write-up with a recommended default, adopted if the owner has not objected by the next spec. If only G5-d fails (or is void), the control of record's statement is carried. If G5-b fails on the proxy-flagged slice, the expected default is a stronger causal manoeuvre detector (a learned change detector on the bearing residuals) before any further statement work.
